description: The plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three models, LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B, pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The x-axis is labeled but the label is not visible, has a linear scale, ranges from 5 to 7, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is also labeled but the label is not visible, has a linear scale, ranges from approximately 8 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains three lines: a blue line with circular markers and a solid style representing LLaMA1-7B, which starts at around 9.5 at x=5, increases to around 11 at x=5.5, then decreases to around 10.5 at x=7; a red line with triangular markers and a dashed style representing LLaMA1-13B, which starts at around 8.5 at x=5, increases to around 10.5 at x=6, then remains steady until x=7; and a green line with square markers and a dash-dot style representing Vicuna-7B, which starts at around 17 at x=5, decreases to around 15.5 at x=5.5, then remains steady until x=6 before increasing to around 18.5 at x=7.
